sources.source: AWS Price List Bulk API public JSON files (https://pricing.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/offers/v1.0/aws/{AmazonECS,AmazonEC2,AmazonRDS,AmazonElastiCache,AmazonS3,AWSQueueService,AWSELB,AmazonVPC,AmazonRoute53,AmazonCloudWatch,AWSDataTransfer}/current/<region>/index.json, publication dates 2026-09-11 to 2026-09-25) queried for each of ap-south-1, ap-southeast-1, us-east-1, eu-west-1 on 2026-09-30. Values were read from the source named here on 2026-09-30 and transcribed by hand into this static snapshot; they were not fetched live and are list prices, not an invoice or a quote. Verified line items include Fargate, RDS PostgreSQL, ElastiCache, NAT Gateway, ALB, public IPv4, S3, SQS, Route 53, CloudWatch Logs, EBS and data transfer.

AWS ElastiCache HA node-count assumption and ACM public certificate price come from model knowledge, not from a price feed. Values were read from the source named here on 2026-09-30 and transcribed by hand into this static snapshot; they were not fetched live and are list prices, not an invoice or a quote. Must be refreshed before being relied on.

Azure Retail Prices API (https://prices.azure.com/api/retail/prices, public, unauthenticated) queried for centralindia, southeastasia, eastus, westeurope on 2026-09-30. Values were read from the source named here on 2026-09-30 and transcribed by hand into this static snapshot; they were not fetched live and are list prices, not an invoice or a quote. Verified: Container Apps, Virtual Machines B1ms/B2s/D2s_v5, PostgreSQL Flexible Server compute/storage/backup, Azure Cache for Redis, Blob Hot LRS, Application Gateway v2, public IPv4, internet bandwidth, Log Analytics.

Azure rates derived from a Retail Prices API reading in one region applied to all four regions (Premium SSD v2 IOPS, read for eastus). Values were read from the source named here on 2026-09-30 and transcribed by hand into this static snapshot; they were not fetched live and are list prices, not an invoice or a quote.

Azure NAT Gateway, managed disks, DNS, Storage Queues, HA multipliers and inter-region transfer rates come from model knowledge, not from a price feed (the Retail Prices API filters used returned no NAT Gateway rows). Values were read from the source named here on 2026-09-30 and transcribed by hand into this static snapshot; they were not fetched live and are list prices, not an invoice or a quote. Must be refreshed before being relied on.

Cloud Run instance-based CPU and memory rates parsed from the HTML of https://cloud.google.com/run/pricing on 2026-09-30. Values were read from the source named here on 2026-09-30 and transcribed by hand into this static snapshot; they were not fetched live and are list prices, not an invoice or a quote. The region-to-tier assignment (Tier 1: asia-south1, us-central1, europe-west1; Tier 2: asia-southeast1) was inferred from the page's own per-region price blocks (each region label followed by its block, consistent across six tables) and matches Cloud Run's documented tiers as remembered; treat it as parsed, not re-verified against the docs page.

Compute Engine, Cloud NAT, external IPv4, Persistent Disk, snapshot, Cloud Storage and internet egress rates read on 2026-09-30 from the third-party file https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Cyclenerd/google-cloud-pricing-cost-calculator/master/pricing.yml (generated 2026-09-24 from the Cloud Billing Catalog API by that project). The official Cloud Billing Catalog API requires an API key and was NOT queried directly. Values were read from the source named here on 2026-09-30 and transcribed by hand into this static snapshot; they were not fetched live and are list prices, not an invoice or a quote.

Cloud SQL and Memorystore regional rates are DERIVED: us-central1 list price from model knowledge (vCPU 0.0413 and memory 0.0070 per GB-hour; Memorystore Basic 0.049 per GB-hour) scaled by the regional Compute Engine price ratio from the third-party mirror. Not read from a price feed for asia-south1, asia-southeast1 or europe-west1. Values were read from the source named here on 2026-09-30 and transcribed by hand into this static snapshot; they were not fetched live and are list prices, not an invoice or a quote. Must be refreshed before being relied on.

Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud DNS, Cloud Logging, Cloud Tasks, Cloud Storage request classes, HA multipliers and inter-region egress rates come from model knowledge, not from a price feed. Values were read from the source named here on 2026-09-30 and transcribed by hand into this static snapshot; they were not fetched live and are list prices, not an invoice or a quote. Must be refreshed before being relied on.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure public price list API (https://apexapps.oracle.com/pls/apex/cetools/api/v1/products/?currencyCode=USD, lastUpdated 2026-09-23) read on 2026-09-30. OCI list prices are the same in every commercial region. Values were read from the source named here on 2026-09-30 and transcribed by hand into this static snapshot; they were not fetched live and are list prices, not an invoice or a quote. Verified: Compute E4, Database with PostgreSQL, Object Storage, Queue, Flexible Load Balancer, Block Volume, DNS, Logging, outbound data transfer.

OCI rates derived by arithmetic from official price-list components (E4 OCPU + memory, Redis per GB-hour, VPU pricing, flexible bandwidth). Values were read from the source named here on 2026-09-30 and transcribed by hand into this static snapshot; they were not fetched live and are list prices, not an invoice or a quote.

OCI NAT gateway, public IP, HA node count, backup storage and inter-region metering come from model knowledge, not from a price feed. Values were read from the source named here on 2026-09-30 and transcribed by hand into this static snapshot; they were not fetched live and are list prices, not an invoice or a quote. Must be refreshed before being relied on.

Zenith managed tier internal planning prices. These are assumptions, not published rates and not derived from any provider price list; there is no public Zenith price page. Regions are placeholders for where the managed tier may run. Must be replaced by the real price book before managed-tier estimates are shown to users.

AWS Certificate Manager official pricing page read on 2026-10-05 and transcribed into this snapshot for aws.acm.public_cert_month only, in the four existing AWS regions. Non-exportable public certificates used with integrated AWS services have no additional certificate fee. Exportable certificates, ACME issuance/API usage and Private CA are not covered. The page provides no effective-start date for this no-charge rate; retrieval date is not an effective date. All other AWS evidence remains dated 2026-09-30.

Azure Retail Prices API public unauthenticated responses read on 2026-10-05 and transcribed for azure.public_ip.hour only, separately filtered for centralindia, southeastasia, eastus and westeurope: serviceName Virtual Network, productName IP Addresses, skuName Standard, priceType Consumption. Exactly one USD Standard IPv4 Static Public IP meter per region: 0.005 per 1 Hour, effectiveStartDate 2018-06-01T00:00:00Z, meterId 9c150bf9-2bad-430e-a53c-c213804f49ef. Public IP Prefix and Global/Basic SKUs are excluded. All other Azure evidence remains dated 2026-09-30.
